implementation: Rows that are not repeated are not repeat-checked.

The shared sealed measure takes two full twin rows, so a row that is not repeated (or whose fresh answer is not one finite row of the graded width) is given its own graded answer as its twin. Its internal paired_repeat then reads PASS; that verdict is never exported (the aggregate counts only FAIL) and has no score effect (score_case reads the twin only inside its gates; the pool rows' twins are never read).
The bit-exact whole-row check (subset_repeat_evidence.rows_agree) is the decisive gate over every repeated row; a failure sets native_motor_valid and complete_fixed_coverage FAIL, A None, D 0.

The side file binds the served version, the evaluation pack digest and the submission id; the scorer requires exactly the bank's sealed cells, exactly k keyed rows outside them (k from the promise), and the ledger identity the door gives this submission's repeat or its one wall retry.

science_ruling.source: codex-queue/handoff-20261021/TEAM_BOARD.md, board Sun 15 Nov (the ~08:2x ruling and the later Q1/Q2 ruling)
summary: (1) The subset repeat is its own mandatory gate: a per-grade secret key, never disclosed, draws rows of the graded bank after the graded predictions are committed; they are re-predicted in ONE fresh process (same image, state and inputs). A repeat failure leaves the grade unscored, the candidate's failure, exactly as a pair mismatch today (native_motor_valid and complete_fixed_coverage FAIL, A None, D 0).

(Q1 = B, STRATIFIED) The repeat re-runs ALL the sealed cells (30) PLUS k keyed rows drawn over the REST of the graded bank, excluding the sealed cells, in one op; the promise's k applies to the keyed part.

(Q2) The decisive rule: each repeated row must equal the graded row BIT-EXACT over the WHOLE 240-wide row. Any differing value, or a malformed or non-finite fresh answer, is a repeat FAIL. Motor's existing torque-slice paired_repeat gate stays as it is.
(2) The repeat feeds pass/fail only and never changes a score value.
(3) 'Three runs agree' (graded vs repeat 1 vs repeat 2) becomes graded vs the fresh repeat on the repeated rows, for Motor 1.8 only.
